Devendra Fadnavis denies shift to national politics, focuses on Maharashtra

Devendra Fadnavis, the leader of the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) in Maharashtra, has denied rumors about his potential shift to national politics. He stated that he is committed to serving the people of Maharashtra and will not leave the state. The opposition party alleged that Fadnavis was trying to gain popularity by making such claims. Fadnavis claimed that he had never been interested in national politics and would continue to focus on the development of Maharashtra.
